prompt:
『虚空の果て、眠りし竜の脈動を聞け。天を穿つ角、万物を灼く魔力の源泉よ。
契約の印章を以て命ず。
我が右腕に集え、片手にして両刃、自由にして絶対の断罪者。
龍鱗の護りを刃に宿し、破滅の咆哮を閃光に変えよ。来たりて裁け——』

promptTranslations.en:
"Hear the pulse of the sleeping dragon at the edge of the void. Horn that pierces the heavens, fountainhead of magic that scorches all creation.
By the seal of the covenant, I command.
Gather upon my right arm, one-handed yet double-edged, the free and absolute condemner.
Harbor the protection of dragon scales upon your blade, and turn the roar of ruin into a flash of light. Come forth and pass judgment——"

summaryTranslations.en: A fantasy incantation-style prompt summoning a double-edged sword imbued with the power of dragon scales and flashes of light.

translations.zh: “倾听虚空尽头沉睡之龙的脉动。贯穿苍穹之角，灼烧万物的魔力源泉啊。以契约之印起誓下令。汇聚于吾之右臂，单手执双刃，自由且绝对的断罪者。将龙鳞之庇护宿于剑刃，化毁灭之咆哮为闪光。降临并制裁吧——”
translations.en: “Hear the pulse of the sleeping dragon at the edge of the void. Horn piercing the heavens, fountainhead of searing magic. By the seal of covenant I command: Gather to my right arm, a one-handed double-edged blade, the free and absolute judge. Imbue the blade with dragon scales, turn the roar of ruin into a flash. Come and pass judgment—”
